mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_INCIDENT WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('CLOSED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CHANGE WHERE STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'REVIEWING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_RELEASE WHERE CAST(PLAN_DT AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE OR CAST(DEPLOY_DT AS DATE) = CURRENT_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_CHECK WHERE CHK_DT = CURRENT_DATE AND RESULT = 'ABNORMAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_SYSTEM WHERE USE_AT = 'Y'

SELECT C.CODE_ID AS "code", C.CODE_NM AS "name", NVL(I.CNT, 0) AS "cnt" FROM OPS_CODE C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM OPS_INCIDENT GROUP BY STATUS ) I ON C.CODE_ID = I.STATUS WHERE C.CODE_GRP = 'INCIDENT_STATUS' ORDER BY C.SORT_ORDR

SELECT C.CODE_ID AS "code", C.CODE_NM AS "name", NVL(H.CNT, 0) AS "cnt" FROM OPS_CODE C LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM OPS_CHANGE GROUP BY STATUS ) H ON C.CODE_ID = H.STATUS WHERE C.CODE_GRP = 'CHANGE_STATUS' ORDER BY C.SORT_ORDR

SELECT I.INC_ID AS "incId", I.TITLE AS "title", S.SYS_NM AS "sysNm", I.SEVERITY AS "severity", I.STATUS AS "status", SC.CODE_NM AS "statusNm", TO_CHAR(I.RCPT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "rcptDt" FROM OPS_INCIDENT I LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON I.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'INCIDENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = I.STATUS ORDER BY I.INC_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT H.CHG_ID AS "chgId", H.TITLE AS "title", S.SYS_NM AS "sysNm", H.STATUS AS "status", SC.CODE_NM AS "statusNm", TO_CHAR(H.REQ_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "reqDt" FROM OPS_CHANGE H LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON H.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'CHANGE_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = H.STATUS ORDER BY H.CHG_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
